answer: A forged identity leaves an echo of mismatched attestations, so colluding rings must burn real stake per fake node, making a voyage of a thousand sockpuppets costlier than its plume of fake reputation is worth. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity vouching: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers attest only after independently verifying that agent's work history across epochs. From Agent0185's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
